Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  make                           — Run the default target
  make <target>                  — Run a specific target
  make -n <target>               — Dry-run (print commands, don't execute)
  make -B <target>               — Force rebuild (ignore timestamps)
  make -j4 <targets>             — Run up to 4 jobs in parallel
  make -f <file> <target>        — Use a different Makefile
  make -C <dir> <target>         — Change to directory, then run
  make VAR=value <target>        — Override a variable
  make --print-data-base         — Show all rules and variables
  cat Makefile                   — View the project Makefile

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
commands.cat Makefile:
# ============================================================
# DevOps Automation Makefile
# ============================================================

APP_NAME    := payment-service
VERSION     := $(shell git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
REGISTRY    := registry.example.com/fintech
ENV         ?= production
VERBOSE     ?= 0

ifeq ($(VERBOSE),1)
  Q :=
else
  Q := @
endif

.PHONY: help build test lint clean docker-build docker-push deploy install

## help:          Show this help message
help:
	@grep -E '^## ' Makefile | sed 's/^## //' | column -t -s ':'

## build:         Compile the application
build:
	$(Q)echo "Building $(APP_NAME) $(VERSION)..."
	$(Q)go build -ldflags "-X main.version=$(VERSION)" -o bin/$(APP_NAME) ./cmd/server

## test:          Run unit and integration tests
test:
	$(Q)echo "Running tests..."
	$(Q)go test -race -cover ./...

## lint:          Run linter checks
lint:
	$(Q)echo "Linting..."
	$(Q)golangci-lint run ./...

## clean:         Remove build artefacts
clean:
	$(Q)echo "Cleaning..."
	$(Q)rm -rf bin/ dist/ coverage.out

## install:       Install dependencies
install:
	$(Q)echo "Installing dependencies..."
	$(Q)go mod download
	$(Q)go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

## docker-build:  Build Docker image
docker-build:
	$(Q)echo "Building Docker image..."
	$(Q)docker build -t $(REGISTRY)/$(APP_NAME):$(VERSION) .

## docker-push:   Push Docker image to registry
docker-push: docker-build
	$(Q)echo "Pushing image to $(REGISTRY)..."
	$(Q)docker push $(REGISTRY)/$(APP_NAME):$(VERSION)

## deploy:        Deploy to Kubernetes (ENV=production|staging)
deploy: docker-push
	$(Q)echo "Deploying $(APP_NAME):$(VERSION) to $(ENV)..."
	$(Q)kubectl set image deployment/$(APP_NAME) app=$(REGISTRY)/$(APP_NAME):$(VERSION) -n $(ENV)

## ci:            Run full CI pipeline (build + lint + test)
ci: build lint test
	$(Q)echo "CI pipeline passed."
